additional_info.subject: ID0382825-DC/SI-D/FR[AFGQ1] - OCPP offline CRM:00315001873
additional_info.body:
Dear Leo,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / PD 170001302
ChargerID/Serial No.
: 80sMov
Problem Description
: The OCPP connection is not properly established.
Troubleshooting
:
From our backend we couldn't ping the OCPP router which is connected to your backend. I would recommend doing a reboot to see if the router comes back online.
If it comes back online, let's keep monitoring for any recurring events.
If it doesn't come back online, we need to make sure that the router is indeed getting 24V to work.
A second topic, I could access the 2nd charger from Greenspot in Marennes, which was toggling online and offline. There was a configuration set which is “WAN Failover (Wired) = True”, this meant that if Mobile connection was lost, then Wired connection would be turned ON as a failover.
Since there is no Wired connection, the connection to the backend would be off for more time than it should.
I removed this configuration and will do the same for the 1st charger when I can. There is someone charging so I cannot reboot the charger.
Please give me your permission to reboot it when possible.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0382825
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
Please do not
change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.
